# DEVDESK-142 (A-06) — `:jobs` migrated to the activity column, plus the A-16 guard skeleton

Architect plan, 2026-11-07. Base: `main` at `f7f416d` (137, 138, 139, 140, 141 merged).
Story: `docs/product/activity-indicator/stories.md` §A-06 (criteria 1-7; 8-9 are user
decisions after use, no code). Guard: §A-16 (skeleton only here; DEVDESK-143 completes it).

## Open questions (defaults used by this plan — confirm or change before step 1)

- **Q1 — State text column colours.** Today `done` is green (`StatusOKStyle`), `queued`
  dim, `cancelled`/`skipped` orange. Criterion 2 says "done is not green" for the dot.
  (a) keep the State column as is; (b) colour the State word with `indicator.Style(state)`
  so the row has one colour source. **Default: (b).** Rule 122 (nominal state not green)
  and Rule 125 (no green for done) argue for it; a green word beside a neutral `◉`
  would contradict the dot.
- **Q2 — footer progress after the row detail.** ux.md §3.1 shows
  `● Scanning ~/w/app/api · 3/12 scans`; today the view says `N jobs running`.
  (a) keep `N jobs running` as the progress (A-05 c.3 "global progress");
  (b) the selected run's own `3/12`; (c) none. **Default: (a)** — the run's own counter
  is already in the Progress column of the same row.
- **Q3 — sentences ux.md does not spell.** Defaults:
  failed run → `⊗ <label>: last <kind> failed — <cause>`, cause = the failed item's
  Detail when exactly one failed, else `<n> of <m> targets failed`;
  done item (no timestamp of its own) → `◉ Scan of <target> finished`;
  done run under one minute → `finished now` (`theme.TimeAgo` verbatim, Rule 127).

Hypothèse: the footer status of a failed row stays at the Info level (the glyph says it).
Hypothèse: `Kind` title-cased for the lead (`Scan of`, `Pull of`, `Index of`).

## Design decision — how the guard reads a view's tables (no ADR: local, reversible)

| | A. exported accessor (recommended) | B. per-package helper |
|---|---|---|
| How | `datatable.Model.Shapes()` (non-generic) + each migrated view exports `ActivityTables()`; one test in `internal/app` builds every view with `createView` | each view's own test calls `testutil.AssertActivityTable`; central list only for source scans |
| Catches a view that forgot the test | yes (router enumerates views) | no |
| Cost | one read-only exported method per migrated view, used by tests only | none in production |

A wins on criterion 1 of A-16 ("fails naming the view") — B cannot see a view nobody tested.

## Steps

### Step 1 — job row sentences and state mapping in `components` (S) — parallel with step 3

Files: `internal/ui/components/job_activity.go` (new), `job_activity_test.go` (new),
`docs/architecture/ui-components.md` (section "One constructor of sentences").

```go
// RunIndicator maps a run's state onto the activity column.
func RunIndicator(s jobs.RunState) indicator.State
// ItemIndicator maps one target's state onto the activity column.
func ItemIndicator(s jobs.ItemState) indicator.State
// DescribeRun is the footer sentence of a :jobs run row; State == RunIndicator(r.State()).
func DescribeRun(r jobs.Run) RowActivity
// DescribeItem is the same for one target of a run of kind k.
func DescribeItem(k jobs.Kind, it jobs.Item) RowActivity
```

Mapping: queued→Queued, running→Running, done→Done, failed→Failed, cancelled→Cancelled
(run); skipped→Skipped (item). Never Idle. Sentences reuse `RowDetail`, `targetDisplay`,
`causeSuffix`, `oneLine` (same file package, no copy).

Tests (table-driven, `go test ./internal/ui/components -run 'Indicator|DescribeRun|DescribeItem'`):
- every `RunState`/`ItemState` maps to a distinct non-Idle state; done → `indicator.Done`.
- running run `~/w/app` scan → `● Scanning ~/w/app`; queued → `◴ Queued: scan ~/w/app`
  (same text as `DescribeRow` for the same op — compare both builders).
- done run EndedAt = now−2 min → `◉ Scan of ~/w/app finished 2 min ago`; zero EndedAt → `finished`.
- cancelled run → `⊘ Scan of ~/w/app was cancelled`.
- skipped item Detail "already there" → `⊖ Sync of ~/w/a skipped — already there`; empty Detail → no ` — `.
- failed item Detail "scan failed: db" → `⊗ ~/w/a: last scan failed — db`; failed run with 1 / 3 failed items (Q3).
- glyph is always `indicator.Glyph(state, true)`; `DescribeRun(r).State == RunIndicator(r.State())`.
- multi-line / bidi Detail stays one line.
- Cancelled run fixture: build through a `jobs.Registry` (admit, `Cancel`, settle items, `Snapshot`) — `cancelled` is unexported.
- `TestNoViewSpellsARowActivityPhrase` still passes (optionally add ` was cancelled` to its patterns).

Done when: tests green, `mise run lint` clean, ui-components.md lists the two builders.

### Step 2 — `:jobs` on the activity column (M) — after step 1

Files: `internal/ui/jobsview/{model.go,state.go,update.go,view.go}`, `frame_test.go`,
`jobsview_test.go`, `docs/architecture/app-shell.md` (§ "The `:jobs` view").

- `runRow`/`itemRow` lose `Frame`; `Model.frame` removed.
- Column 0 of both tables: `datatable.IndicatorColumn(func(r runRow) indicator.State { return components.RunIndicator(r.Run.State()) }, nil, nil)` (items: `ItemIndicator`). No Less, no Search.
- `runStateGlyph`/`itemStateGlyph` deleted; `runStateStyle`/`itemStateStyle` per Q1.
- Kind `Search` unchanged (`kind + " " + state`); item State `Search` unchanged.
- `handleFrameMsg`: `SetBlinkPhase(msg.Blink)` on both tables + `footer.SetSpinnerFrame`; no `refreshRows` (phase is read at render).
- `status()`: `Status{Text: progress (Q2), Detail: selected row's DescribeRun/DescribeItem .Detail, Spinner: detail zero && progress != ""}`.
- Help: Runs/Targets sections describe column 0 as "the activity indicator (legend below)" — no `theme.IconOK/IconError/IconPending/IconSkipped/IconCanceled`, no "spinner"; append `indicator.Legend(indicator.JobsLegend...)`. `GetShortcuts()` untouched.

Tests (`go test ./internal/ui/jobsview`):
- column 0 of both tables: Title "", `SizingFixed`, `IconColumnWidth`, Indicator set, Less nil, Search nil.
- each state renders its glyph in the row (`View()` contains `◉ ⊗ ⊘ ◴` for runs, `⊖ ◴` for items); no `IconOK`/frame.
- `FrameMsg{Blink:false}` → running row shows `○`; `{Blink:true}` → `●`; a queued row stays `◴` in both phases.
- a done row's first cell is never painted with `ColorSuccess`/`StatusOKStyle` foreground.
- `/failed` still filters runs (Kind Search); `/skipped` filters targets.
- footer with a running run selected: contains `● Scanning ~/work` and `1 job running`, no spinner frame; done run selected: `◉ Scan of ~/work finished`; error `Warn` from a refused `K` wins over the detail, detail returns on `ClearFooterMsg`.
- Rule 116 at 60: after `resize(60, 20)` both `runTable.RenderedWidth()` and (after `→`) `itemTable.RenderedWidth()` == 58.
- help: contains `indicator.Legend(indicator.JobsLegend...).Body`; `ShortcutKeys` identical before/after (both levels).
- rewrite `TestAFrameMovesTheRowSpinner`, `TestAFrameMovesTheFooterSpinner`, `TestARunningRunCarriesTheRoutersFrame`, `TestASettledRunShowsItsOutcomeRatherThanASpinner`, `TestNoCellCarriesAnEscapeSequence` (drop `Frame:`).
Also run: `go test ./internal/ui/keymap ./internal/ui/oci_resources -run 'Glyph|Shortcut'`, `go test ./internal/app -run 'Jobs|Animation|Motion|Reporter'`.

Done when: criteria 1-6 observable, `mise run test-race` clean on `internal/app` and `internal/ui/jobsview`.

### Step 3 — non-generic column shape in `datatable` (S) — parallel with step 1

Files: `internal/ui/datatable/shape.go` (new) + `shape_test.go`, `docs/architecture/ui-components.md` (datatable section).

```go
// ColumnShape is what a guard reads of a column without knowing T.
type ColumnShape struct {
    Title     string
    Sizing    Sizing
    MinWidth  int
    Indicator, Less, Search bool
}
func (m *Model[T]) Shapes() []ColumnShape
// ActivityTable is the face of a table a cross-view guard inspects.
type ActivityTable interface { Shapes() []ColumnShape; RenderedWidth() int }
```
Tests (`go test ./internal/ui/datatable -run Shape`): an `IndicatorColumn` reports Indicator=true, Title "", SizingFixed, IconColumnWidth; a column with Less/Search reports them; `*Model[T]` satisfies `ActivityTable` (compile-time assertion).

### Step 4 — A-16 guard skeleton (M) — after steps 2 and 3

Files: `internal/ui/jobsview/model.go` (+ `ActivityTables() map[string]datatable.ActivityTable` returning `"jobs/runs"`, `"jobs/targets"`), `internal/app/activity_guard_test.go` (new), `docs/architecture/app-shell.md` (new § "The activity-column guard"), `docs/backlog.md` entry.

Test content:
- `migratedTables` = {`jobs/runs`, `jobs/targets`} → view `command.ViewJobs`.
- `pendingTables` (table → story), from inventory.md's validated list: ws (A-07), sec inventory (A-08), OCI images + registry browser (A-09a), OCI networks/volumes/registries (A-09b), explorer tree (A-10a), clone list (A-10b), templates (A-11), netdiag ports (A-12), agent-usage agents (A-13), containers (A-14). `maxPendingTables` = that count; `len(pendingTables) > max` fails ("the list may only shrink").
- `exemptViews` (view → reason): dashboard, status, git-auth, configuration, about, files, viewer (inventory "sans objet"/"hors lot").
- **Runtime (c.1, 4, 5-help, 6):** for every `command.ViewType` the router builds (`routerAt` + `a.createView`): an `ActivityView` must be migrated; a non-`ActivityView` must be pending or exempt, else fail naming it. Each migrated table: column 0 shape check; after `WindowSizeMsg{60, 30}`, `RenderedWidth() == 58`; `GetHelpContent().Sections` contains a section equal to `indicator.Legend(...).Title`. A pending table name reported by an `ActivityTables()` → "remove the exception".
- **Source scan (c.2b, 3) on migrated packages only** (`ui/jobsview/`): no `AdvanceSpinner` call, no `StatusColumn:` key, no selector/field named `Frame`/`frame`/`SpinnerFrame` (`RenderedFrame` allowed), no string literal holding an indicator glyph (glyphs come from `indicator.Glyph`).
- c.2a/2c stay with `TestRowAnimationChainsOutsideTheRouterAreDeclared`; 2d with `TestStaticMotionHoldsTheBlinkPhaseOnAndStartsNoChain`; footer half of c.5 and c.7 → DEVDESK-143.
- Red first: run the scan against step-1-only code (jobs still has `Frame`) → must fail naming `ui/jobsview/model.go`.

Command: `go test ./internal/app -run 'Activity|RowAnimation|Reporter' -count=2` and `go test ./internal/ui/oci_resources -run TestNoShortcutAdvertisesAGlyphAsAKey`.

## Docs (same commit as the code of each step)
- `docs/architecture/app-shell.md` §`:jobs`: table "state glyph" → "activity indicator"; replace "The frame rides on the row" by the blink phase read at render; footer row detail; §"Row chains" + new guard §.
- `docs/architecture/ui-components.md`: "No view is wired to it yet" → `:jobs` is; `DescribeRun/DescribeItem`; `Shapes`/`ActivityTable`.
- `docs/backlog.md` §1.1 entry; note the behaviour change: a queued run no longer spins (inventory §3.5).
- No `.claude/rules` change: Rules 121/125 were amended in DEVDESK-137.

## Risks
- `●` vs `◉` the weak pair (ux §2.2a) shows up exactly here: that is what criterion 8 tests with the user.
- Spinner suppressed in the footer whenever a row is selected: intended (row dot moves), but a reader may miss "work is running" when the selected row is settled — the progress text still says `N jobs running`.
- Exported test-only accessor (`ActivityTables`) can be misused as a write path: it returns the read-only interface only.
- `createView` for every view in the guard may touch Docker/keyring at construction: use `routerAt` (session store, isolated HOME); if a constructor dials, mark that view pending/exempt via a stub, never skip silently.

J'ai écrit le plan de DEVDESK-142 (A-06) dans `/home/anthoni/projects/workspace-entire/anthnel/devdesk/.claude/plans/DEVDESK-142-plan.md`. Aucun fichier de code n'a été modifié. Le plan est écrit avec les options recommandées ci-dessous ; seules les étapes 1 et 2 en dépendent.

**Questions bloquantes** (libellés et couleurs visibles par l'utilisateur)
- **Q1 — couleur du mot dans la colonne State.** Aujourd'hui `done` y est vert (`StatusOKStyle`), `queued` gris.
  - (a) on garde.
  - (b) on colore le mot avec `indicator.Style(state)`. **Recommandé** : un mot vert à côté d'un `◉` neutre contredirait la pastille, et les Rules 122 et 125 refusent le vert pour un état terminé.
- **Q2 — ce qui suit le détail de ligne dans le footer.** La maquette (ux.md §3.1) montre `· 3/12 scans`.
  - (a) on garde `N jobs running`. **Recommandé** : le compteur du run est déjà dans sa colonne Progress, sur la même ligne.
  - (b) le `3/12` du run sélectionné.
  - (c) rien.
- **Q3 — phrases absentes de ux.md.**
  - Run en échec : `⊗ <label>: last scan failed — <cause>`. La cause est le Detail de la cible en échec s'il n'y en a qu'une, sinon `<n> of <m> targets failed`.
  - Cible terminée : `◉ Scan of <target> finished`, sans durée, car une cible n'a pas d'horodatage propre.
  - Run fini depuis moins d'une minute : `finished now` (sortie de `theme.TimeAgo` telle quelle, Rule 127).

Hypothèses : le footer d'une ligne en échec reste au niveau Info (le glyphe porte l'état) ; le type d'opération prend une majuscule dans la phrase (`Scan of`, `Pull of`).

**Choix d'architecture (local et réversible, pas d'ADR) : comment le garde-fou A-16 lit les tables.**
- Retenu : chaque vue migrée expose `ActivityTables()`, et le test vit dans `internal/app`. Il construit chaque vue avec `createView` et échoue en nommant toute vue qui n'est ni migrée, ni en attente, ni exemptée.
- Écarté : une fonction d'aide par paquet. Elle ne voit pas une vue que personne n'a testée, alors que le critère 1 de A-16 exige de nommer la vue fautive.
- Coût : une méthode exportée en lecture seule par vue migrée, utilisée seulement par les tests.

**Étapes (TDD, chacune livrable seule)**
1. **Phrases et correspondance d'état dans `components` (S, parallèle à l'étape 3).**
   - Nouveaux fichiers `internal/ui/components/job_activity.go` et `job_activity_test.go`.
   - Fonctions : `RunIndicator(jobs.RunState)`, `ItemIndicator(jobs.ItemState)`, `DescribeRun(jobs.Run) RowActivity`, `DescribeItem(jobs.Kind, jobs.Item) RowActivity`.
   - Raison : `TestNoViewSpellsARowActivityPhrase` interdit à une vue d'écrire ces phrases, et le critère 8 de A-05 veut un seul constructeur.
   - Commande : `go test ./internal/ui/components -run 'Indicator|DescribeRun|DescribeItem'`.
2. **Migration de `:jobs` (M, après l'étape 1).** Fichiers `jobsview/{model,state,update,view}.go` et leurs tests.
   - Les deux tables ont `IndicatorColumn` en colonne 0.
   - Le champ `Frame` disparaît des lignes et du modèle, ainsi que `runStateGlyph` et `itemStateGlyph`.
   - `handleFrameMsg` passe `msg.Blink` à `SetBlinkPhase` et ne reconstruit plus les lignes.
   - `status()` remplit `Status.Detail` avec la phrase de la ligne sélectionnée.
   - L'aide garde ses touches et ajoute `indicator.Legend(indicator.JobsLegend...)` ; `GetShortcuts()` ne change pas.
   - Tests : forme de la colonne, glyphe de chaque état, `○` puis `●` selon la phase, `◴` fixe, `/failed` filtre toujours, texte du footer et priorité d'un `Warn`, Rule 116 à 60 colonnes (`RenderedWidth() == 58`) aux deux niveaux, raccourcis identiques.
   - Cinq tests existants à réécrire (frame, spinner).
   - Commandes : `go test ./internal/ui/jobsview`, `mise run test-race`.
3. **Forme non générique des colonnes dans `datatable` (S, parallèle à l'étape 1).**
   - Nouveau `internal/ui/datatable/shape.go` : `ColumnShape{Title, Sizing, MinWidth, Indicator, Less, Search}`, `(*Model[T]).Shapes()`, interface `ActivityTable{Shapes(); RenderedWidth()}`.
   - Commande : `go test ./internal/ui/datatable -run Shape`.
4. **Squelette du garde-fou A-16 (M, après les étapes 2 et 3).**
   - `jobsview.ActivityTables()` et nouveau `internal/app/activity_guard_test.go`.
   - Trois listes :
     - tables migrées : `jobs/runs`, `jobs/targets` ;
     - tables en attente, avec leur story (de A-07 à A-14, d'après la liste validée d'inventory.md) et un plafond qui interdit d'en ajouter ;
     - vues exemptées, avec leur raison.
   - Vérifications à l'exécution : critères 1, 4, 6 et la moitié « aide » du 5.
   - Analyse des sources des seules vues migrées (critères 2b et 3) : aucun `AdvanceSpinner`, aucun `StatusColumn:`, aucun champ `Frame`/`frame`/`SpinnerFrame` (`RenderedFrame` reste permis), aucun glyphe écrit en dur.
   - Restent à leur place : les critères 2a et 2c dans `TestRowAnimationChainsOutsideTheRouterAreDeclared`, le 2d dans `TestStaticMotionHoldsTheBlinkPhaseOnAndStartsNoChain`. La moitié « footer » du critère 5 et le critère 7 sont reportés à DEVDESK-143.
   - Commande : `go test ./internal/app -run 'Activity|RowAnimation|Reporter' -count=2`.

**Docs, dans le même commit que le code de chaque étape**
- `docs/architecture/app-shell.md` :
  - section `:jobs` : « state glyph » devient la pastille, et « The frame rides on the row » est remplacé par la phase lue au rendu ;
  - nouvelle section sur le garde-fou.
- `docs/architecture/ui-components.md` :
  - « No view is wired to it yet » devient « `:jobs` l'est » ;
  - ajout de `DescribeRun`/`DescribeItem` et de `Shapes`/`ActivityTable`.
- `docs/backlog.md` : nouvelle entrée en §1.1, qui annonce le changement de comportement : un run en file ne tourne plus, il affiche `◴` fixe.
- Aucun changement dans `.claude/rules` : les Rules 121 et 125 ont déjà été amendées dans DEVDESK-137.

**Risques**
- La paire faible `●`/`◉` (ux §2.2a) se croise justement dans `:jobs` ; c'est ce que l'utilisateur juge au critère 8.
- Le spinner du footer disparaît dès qu'une ligne est sélectionnée, ce qui est voulu. Le texte `N jobs running` reste affiché.
- `createView` peut toucher Docker ou le trousseau quand le garde-fou construit chaque vue. Il faut passer par `routerAt` et, si besoin, déclarer la vue concernée plutôt que la sauter en silence.
- Le test d'un run annulé doit passer par un `jobs.Registry` (`Cancel`, puis `Snapshot`), car le champ `cancelled` n'est pas exporté.
